record.context_brief: Banach problem for simple Lebesgue spectrum
record.original_question: Does there exist a measure-preserving automorphism with simple Lebesgue spectrum, meaning Lebesgue spectrum of multiplicity one?

evidence.quote: Проблема Банаха об однократном лебеговском спектре. Другая нерешенная задача из этого списка известна как проблема Банаха.
Q2. Найдется ли автоморфизм пространства с мерой, обладающий однократным лебеговским спектром?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$ be a standard Lebesgue probability space and let $T:X\to X$ be an invertible measure-preserving transformation (automorphism). Associated with $T$ is the Koopman operator $U_T$ acting on $L^2_0(X,\mu)=\{f\in L^2(X,\mu):\int f\,d\mu=0\}$ by $U_Tf=f\circ T$. The operator $U_T$ is unitary, and by the spectral theorem it has a maximal spectral type $\sigma$ (a Borel measure on the unit circle $\mathbb{T}$, defined up to equivalence) and a multiplicity function $m:\mathbb{T}\to\{1,2,\ldots,\infty\}$. One says that $T$ has simple Lebesgue spectrum if $\sigma$ is equivalent to Lebesgue measure on $\mathbb{T}$ and the multiplicity function satisfies $m\equiv 1$ almost everywhere.

Question: Does there exist an automorphism $T$ of a standard probability space $(X,\mathcal{B},\mu)$ whose Koopman operator on $L^2_0(X,\mu)$ has simple Lebesgue spectrum (i.e. Lebesgue spectrum of multiplicity one)?
artifact.status_search_result: The Banach problem on the existence of a finite-measure-preserving automorphism with simple Lebesgue spectrum is widely reported as still open. An analogous problem in the σ-finite / non-singular / conservative setting has been resolved affirmatively (e.g. constructions using L^1-flat Newman polynomials yield conservative ergodic σ-finite measure-preserving transformations with simple Lebesgue spectrum), but the original Banach problem for probability-preserving (finite-measure) automorphisms remains unsolved.

status_evidence.title: Spectral ergodic Banach problem and flat polynomials
status_evidence.snippet: Connects the Banach problem on simple Lebesgue spectrum to the existence of flat polynomials.
status_evidence.claim: The Banach problem is referenced as the central open spectral problem for measure-preserving systems.

status_evidence.title: A non-singular transformation whose spectrum has Lebesgue component of multiplicity one
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs non-singular / σ-finite transformations with simple Lebesgue spectrum component.
status_evidence.claim: Resolutions exist in the non-singular / σ-finite case, but not for finite measure-preserving automorphisms.

status_evidence.title: L^1-flat polynomials and simple Lebesgue spectrum for conservative maps exist
status_evidence.snippet: Conservative measure-preserving maps with simple Lebesgue spectrum exist (σ-finite setting).
status_evidence.claim: The conservative σ-finite case is solved; the probability-preserving Banach problem remains the outstanding open question.
